newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish September T-bill auction draws lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish September T-bill auction draws lower rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Friday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.48 percent for the three-month, 3.60 percent for the six-month and 3.70 percent for the new nine-month series.
One month ago the three-month series, then with a maturity of four months, yielded 3.63 percent, the six-month series, at that time with seven-month maturity, yielded 3.70 percent.

The central bank said it sold 1.1 billion crowns of the three-month series, 6.2 billion crowns worth of the six-month series and 9.2 billion crowns worth of the nine-month series, giving a total of 16.5 billion crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
